metadata.purpose: Deterministic inputs for the GridIQ on-stage demo. Values are labelled demo assumptions or explicit scenario inputs, never BPC measurements.
metadata.warning: The village demand intensity is an explicit demo assumption used only to illustrate right-sizing. It is not a measured village load and must be replaced with a licensed demand benchmark or metered data before any design decision.

village_demand_benchmark.label: Demo sizing assumption (benchmark illustration) — not measured. Replace with a licensed DEL/GEP demand benchmark.
village_demand_benchmark.source_note: Chosen to illustrate evening-peak village demand; GridIQ's own community_costs.json leaves Botswana household intensity as unknown.

A.name: Option A — remote solar-heavy, high import corridor

B.name: Option B — balanced local mix, firm import corridor

e2_system_study.note: Balanced explicit benchmark injections, not real BPC dispatch.

e2_target_loss.scope_note: BPC reports combined T&D/system losses; GridIQ's model is transmission-only and is expected to undercount.
